articles.title_en: Russia’s Higher Education Ministry reportedly tells universities to send 2% of students to military
articles.lead_en: Russia’s Higher Education and Science Ministry told the rectors of the country’s largest universities that at least 2 percent of students must sign contracts with the Defense Ministry, the independent Russian political newsletter Faridaily reported, citing a source acquainted with the rector of a Moscow university. A source in the leadership of a Siberian university confirmed the information.
